repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
t1 = (#Study_Temp).temperatureSensor_temperature
delay(20 MIN)
t2 = (#Study_Temp).temperatureSensor_temperature
diff = t2 - t1
if (diff >= 3) {
    (#Study_AC).airConditioner_setAirConditionerMode("cool")
}

diagnosis.summary: The JoI incorrectly calculated the absolute difference between readings (converting drops to rises), whereas the IR specifies a signed difference check (t2 - t1 >= 3). This caused the JoI to trigger on a temperature drop where the IR would not, evidenced by the extra action at t=1200000 ms.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the absolute value correction logic (if diff < 0 flip). Preserved the signed subtraction and threshold check to match the IR's directional requirement.
